reviewers.summary: The projection validates and orders the five source summaries, and isolates request failures and unsupported contracts. Refresh can still return cached entries outside the current scope.

findingList.message: Filter refresh results to the current scope. Returning cached out-of-scope entries violates the scope criterion and can expose cached coverage in the view (OWASP A01:2025 Broken Access Control).

evidence.codePathTraced: refreshHangarSourceSummary adds fresh results to a map seeded with every previous entry, then returns every case-list entry found in that map without checking the current scope.
evidence.failureScenario: After a refresh with all three cases cached, calling refreshHangarSourceSummary(cases, ['cp-case-b'], reader, previous) requests only case B but returns cached entries for cases A and C too.

reviewers.summary: The named Vitest file is included in the build-and-gate job. The refresh helper can return cached summaries for cases outside the current scope, and the scope test does not exercise refresh with prior entries.

findingList.message: Filter refreshed entries by the current scope before returning them. As written, cached out-of-scope summaries remain visible after scope narrows, violating the criterion that out-of-scope cases produce no entry. The named scope test covers only projectHangarSourceSummary, so it would not catch this refresh path.

evidence.codePathTraced: refreshHangarSourceSummary gets scoped results from projectHangarSourceSummary, merges them with previous entries, then filters the case list only by whether an entry exists in byId; it never applies the current scope to the returned entries.
evidence.failureScenario: After all three cases have previous entries, refresh with scope ['cp-case-b']. The reader is called only for cp-case-b, but the result also includes the cached cp-case-a and cp-case-c entries.

reviewers.summary: The refresh path can expose cached, out-of-scope case summaries after a user's scope narrows. The existing scope test does not exercise refresh with prior entries.

findingList.message: Refresh can return cached summaries for cases outside the current scope. Filter the returned entries by the normalized scope so a scope change cannot expose prior case data. OWASP A01:2025 Broken Access Control.

evidence.codePathTraced: refreshHangarSourceSummary copies every previous entry into byId, then returns case-list entries whenever their IDs are in byId; the return path does not check the current scope.
evidence.failureScenario: A user previously has summaries for cases A and B, then refreshes with scope containing only B and a case list containing A and B. Case A is returned from the previous cache despite being out of scope.
